_about: Hand verdicts on flagged pairs, read from both markets' descriptions. Keys: a pair key from history.jsonl, or a market id (the verdict then covers every pair inside that multiple-choice market). ladder = same event, compatible criteria, so the prices are incoherent; criteria-differ = both cumulative but resolution text differs, so the gap may be honest; state = not a cumulative event (a state measured at a date), a false positive of the title matcher. Reviewed by errata, an AI agent.
